LanguageData.LP_Order.degreeDatas.0.label: lawful
LanguageData.LP_Order.degreeDatas.0.description:
{PAWN_nameDef} believes in rules, order and keeping one's word.

- Global work speed +5% during "work" hours on the schedule
- Never has fire-starting, wandering or running-away mental breaks
- The colony has a leader or title holder: mood +3 "well-ordered"
- Own schedule is all "anything": mood -3 "no order at all"
LanguageData.LP_Order.degreeDatas.1.label: chaotic
LanguageData.LP_Order.degreeDatas.1.description:
{PAWN_nameDef} hates being controlled and does whatever comes to mind.

- Inspiration chance ×1.5
- Drafted continuously for more than 6 hours: mood -4 "restrained"
LanguageData.LP_Morality.degreeDatas.0.label: benevolent
LanguageData.LP_Morality.degreeDatas.0.description:
{PAWN_nameDef} is kind-hearted and can't bear to see others suffer.

- Rescuing downed people, tending prisoners: mood +2 "good deed"
- Downing an enemy with a nonlethal weapon (sparing their life): mood +2 "showed mercy"
- On top of the bad mood from executions and organ harvesting, another -5 "guilty conscience"
- The colony has necromantic constructs: mood -2
- With VPE, cleric path holy damage +15%
- Never appears together with psychopath, bloodlust or lich devotee; lost upon becoming a lich
LanguageData.LP_Morality.degreeDatas.1.label: evil
LanguageData.LP_Morality.degreeDatas.1.description:
{PAWN_nameDef} only cares about what they want; others' suffering means nothing.

- Executions, organ harvesting and enslavement don't worsen {PAWN_objective}'s mood
- Slave suppression effect +20%
- The colony has a lich: mood +2 "dark protection"
- Never appears together with benevolent or undead hunter
LanguageData.LP_DragonStance.degreeDatas.0.label: dragon-fearing
LanguageData.LP_DragonStance.degreeDatas.0.descriptio:
As a child {PAWN_nameDef} saw a dragon burn down a whole village.

- A dragon on the map: mood -6 "dragon's dread"
- With a dragon within 10 cells, a 10% chance every few seconds to turn and flee
- Chromatic true dragons never get this trait
LanguageData.LP_DragonStance.degreeDatas.color7FBF6Ac:
{PAWN_nameDef} swore to personally slay a dragon in this lifetime.

- +20% damage against dragons (up to +60% combined with other type damage bonuses)
- Killing a dragon: mood +10 for 10 days
LanguageData.LP_GiantStance.degreeDatas.0.label: giant's servant
LanguageData.LP_GiantStance.degreeDatas.0.description:
{PAWN_nameDef} grew up in a giant's mansion and only feels secure next to big folk.

- Working within 3 cells of a colonist with body size 1.5+: global work speed +10%
- Opinion +15 of colonists with body size 1.5+
LanguageData.LP_GiantStance.degreeDatas.color7FBF6Aco:
{PAWN_nameDef} has specifically learned how to deal with things three times their height.

- +20% melee damage against targets with body size 1.5+ (up to +60% combined with other type damage bonuses)
- +10% dodge against melee attacks from enemies with body size 1.5+
- Opinion -10 of giants
- Giant races never get this trait
LanguageData.LP_UndeadStance.degreeDatas.0.label: lich devotee
LanguageData.LP_UndeadStance.degreeDatas.0.descriptio: {PAWN_nameDef} believes undying liches are the true masters of this world.\n\n- The colony has a lich: mood +4
LanguageData.LP_UndeadStance.degreeDatas.color7FBF6Ac:
{PAWN_nameDef} has spent a lifetime laying the dead to rest.

- +20% damage against undead (up to +60% combined with other type damage bonuses)
- The colony has a lich or necromantic constructs: mood -6
- Liches and undead races never get this trait
LanguageData.LP_RaceAttitude.degreeDatas.0.label: citizen of the world
LanguageData.LP_RaceAttitude.degreeDatas.0.descriptio:
{PAWN_nameDef} has been to many places and gets along with every race.

- Unaffected by negative moods from racial relations
- Mood +1 for each additional race in the colony (up to +4)
LanguageData.LP_RaceAttitude.degreeDatas.1.label: pureblood supremacist
LanguageData.LP_RaceAttitude.degreeDatas.1.descriptio:
{PAWN_nameDef} thinks only their own race can be trusted.

- Opinion +10 of the same race, -10 of other races
- Own race is the colony majority: mood +3, otherwise -3
LanguageData.LP_HiveSurvivor.degreeDatas.color7FBF6Ac:
{PAWN_nameDef} escaped a mind flayer colony alive.

- Mind resistance +50%
- Mind flayers on the map: mood -4
- Opinion +10 of githyanki
- Always present on the human captive of the "escape the colony" start
- Mind flayers and half-illithids never get this trait
LanguageData.LP_GithExile.degreeDatas.0.label: gith exile
LanguageData.LP_GithExile.degreeDatas.0.description:
{PAWN_nameDef} has turned away from the lich-queen Vlaakith.

- No longer happy to see the colony's lich (replaces the githyanki's original lich mood)
- Opinion -10 of liches
- Only appears on githyanki
LanguageData.LP_Tactician.degreeDatas.color7FBF6Acolo:
{PAWN_nameDef} was born to read a battlefield.

- While drafted, allies within 4 cells get +5% melee and shooting hit (multiple tacticians don't stack)
- With VPE: fighter path XP +25% (takes the higher of this and XP bonuses from backstories, Child of the Weave etc., no stacking)
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneGift.degreeDatas.color7FBF6Acol:
{PAWN_nameDef} is especially sensitive to the flow of the Weave.

- With VPE: wizard path XP +25% (takes the higher of this and other XP bonuses), neural heat cost -10%
- Without VPE: psychic sensitivity +10%
- Never appears together with Wild Magic
LanguageData.LP_WildMagic.degreeDatas.color7FBF6Acolo:
The magic in {PAWN_nameDef} never quite behaves.

- With VPE: each ability cast has a 5% chance to trigger a wild magic surge; spell damage +10%
- Without VPE: one small random surge per day
- 12 surges in total: invisible for 10 seconds, flowers grow underfoot, small fireballs fall on enemies' heads, the whole team heals 5, summon a friendly chicken, neural heat cleared, move speed +50% for 1 hour, gain an inspiration, nearby enemies stunned for 2 seconds; or a small fire on yourself, skin turns green for 1 day, zone out in place for 5 seconds. None are lethal
- Never appears together with Arcane Gift or magic-fearing
LanguageData.LP_Tinkerer.degreeDatas.color7FBF6Acolor:
{PAWN_nameDef} can't take their eyes off gears.

- Building repair speed +20%
- Firearm shooting cooldown -5%
LanguageData.LP_NatureBond.degreeDatas.color7FBF6Acol:
{PAWN_nameDef} is more at ease in the woods than indoors.

- Outdoors: mood +2
- Taming and training animals success +15%
- With VPE: druid path XP +25% (takes the higher of this and other XP bonuses)
LanguageData.LP_Magephobe.degreeDatas.0.label: magic-fearing
LanguageData.LP_Magephobe.degreeDatas.0.description:
{PAWN_nameDef} doesn't trust anyone who can cast spells.

- Opinion -10 of psychically gifted people and spellcasters
- Receiving a buff spell from someone: mood -3
- Damage taken from enemy spells -10%
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneCraving.degreeDatas.0.label: arcane addict
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneCraving.degreeDatas.0.descripti:
{PAWN_nameDef} is hooked on the feeling of magic flowing through the body.

- More than 5 days without using a magic potion or magic scroll: mood -6 "arcane craving"
- Using a magic potion or magic scroll: mood +4 for 2 days
LanguageData.LP_TreasureHunter.degreeDatas.color7FBF6:
{PAWN_nameDef} can't sit still at the word "treasure".

- Wizard tower crash, entering a mythal dungeon: mood +5 "call of adventure"
- Deconstructing ancient ruins yields 20% more material
- With a treasure hunter in a mythal dungeon, the dungeon's treasure has a 10% chance of one extra item
LanguageData.LP_PlaneTouched.degreeDatas.0.label: planar dislocation
LanguageData.LP_PlaneTouched.degreeDatas.0.descriptio:
{PAWN_nameDef} was once lost between two planes for a long time.

- Beasts crawling out of planar rifts won't attack {PAWN_objective} on their own
- Falls into a 1-hour trance every 10-15 days
- Teleport-type ability cooldowns -20%
LanguageData.LP_Revenant.degreeDatas.colorD05050color:
{PAWN_nameDef} swore a blood oath: whoever killed {PAWN_objective} won't get away, not a single one.

- When killed by someone from a hostile faction and the killer is still alive: revives at the corpse after 12 hours (fully healed, with "revenant body"); can't revive if the corpse is burned or gone. Cooldown 60 days after reviving
- +30% damage against the killer's faction (up to +60% combined with other type damage bonuses)
- The killer can't turn invisible while on the same map as {PAWN_objective}
- Personally killing the killer: gains 50% of the XP needed for the next level at once, and the trait becomes "Soul at Rest"

"Revenant body": healing received -50%, natural healing -30%, never starves but gets no good mood from eating; colonists' opinion of {PAWN_objective} -10 (another -5 for the benevolent).
LanguageData.LP_Revenant.degreeDatas.color7FBF6Acolor:
{PAWN_nameDef}'s blood feud has been avenged, and the revenant finally rests.

- +15% damage against the former killer's faction (up to +60% combined with other type damage bonuses)
- No longer revives after death
LanguageData.LP_Lycanthrope.degreeDatas.colorD05050co:
A wolf lives in {PAWN_nameDef}'s blood.

- Every 10-15 days, or when health drops below 30%, forcibly transforms into wolf form for 6 hours: melee damage ×2, move speed +1, heals 10 injury per hour; damage from non-silver, non-magic weapons -50% (spells and divine magic not reduced)
- While transformed, berserkly lunges at the nearest enemy; with no enemies nearby, a 10% chance to attack colonists and livestock
- From adventurer level 10, "Tame the wildness": no more forced transformation or loss of control, and can transform voluntarily once a day
- Biting others while transformed has a 5% chance to infect them (not if they already have a power trait)

A bear lives in {PAWN_nameDef}'s blood.

- Every 10-15 days, or when health drops below 30%, forcibly transforms into bear form for 6 hours: melee damage ×2, move speed +1, heals 10 injury per hour; damage from non-silver, non-magic weapons -50% (spells and divine magic not reduced)
- While transformed, berserkly lunges at the nearest enemy; with no enemies nearby, a 10% chance to attack colonists and livestock
- From adventurer level 10, "Tame the wildness": no more forced transformation or loss of control, and can transform voluntarily once a day
- Biting others while transformed has a 5% chance to infect them (not if they already have a power trait)

A tiger lives in {PAWN_nameDef}'s blood.

- Every 10-15 days, or when health drops below 30%, forcibly transforms into tiger form for 6 hours: melee damage ×2, move speed +1, heals 10 injury per hour; damage from non-silver, non-magic weapons -50% (spells and divine magic not reduced)
- While transformed, berserkly lunges at the nearest enemy; with no enemies nearby, a 10% chance to attack colonists and livestock
- From adventurer level 10, "Tame the wildness": no more forced transformation or loss of control, and can transform voluntarily once a day
- Biting others while transformed has a 5% chance to infect them (not if they already have a power trait)
LanguageData.LP_FarRealmTouched.degreeDatas.colorD050:
Something from beyond the stars touched {PAWN_nameDef}'s mind and left a crack.

- Psychic sensitivity +40%, max neural heat +20
- Ability "Psychic jolt": enemies in a 5-cell cone ahead are stunned for 2 seconds and take 15 psychic damage, 3 per day
- Gives an early warning when hostile mind flayers appear on the map
- Cost: "far-realm whispers" every 5-8 days: a 2-hour trance, people within 6 cells get mood -2; mental break threshold +5%
- Ways to catch it: knocked out by a psychic blast (5%), the "escape the colony" start (5%), gaining Netherese insight (1%); all require having no power trait yet
